verdict.rationale: BVNK is API-first. Its docs say wallets and other functions can be managed via the API as well as the Portal, and requests are signed with key-based Hawk authentication, which suits non-interactive automation. A sandbox with a pay-in simulation endpoint supports automated test runs, and a probe found an official CLI repo (bvnk/agent-wallet-cli). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, details of the CLI's headless usage, independent hands-on corroboration.
